prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high-detail production 2D character animation SPRITE ATLAS on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Reference images show the original Lizards Kingdom design. Preserve the character's specific reptilian face, slender athletic proportions, long tapered tail, swept-back head spines, dark weathered travelling cloak, leather belts and bracers. Refine individual scales, amber eyes, claws, stitching, cloth folds, metalwork, rim lighting. Hand-painted intricate dark-fantasy illustration, NOT pixel art, NOT a 3D render, NOT a cute chibi redesign.
CRITICAL TECHNICAL LAYOUT: square image, preferably 2048 by 2048 or larger. EXACTLY 16 isolated full-body sprites in a regular 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW grid of equal square cells. No grid lines, no text, no numbers, no labels, no floor shadows, no backdrop, no effects. Every sprite faces RIGHT in a consistent side view. Identical character size and anatomy, identical clothing and weapon in every cell. Keep entire tail, head, feet and weapon INSIDE each cell with generous transparent space; no overlap. Hip/body center anchored horizontally at 58% of each cell (tail extends left). Feet baseline is 88% down each cell for grounded poses. Standing head around 18% down cell. Maintain world scale in airborne poses, do not independently enlarge smaller poses.
Animation sequence reading order:
Row 1 (4 frames): breathing idle loop: relaxed standing, inhale with shoulders slightly lifted, peak breath cloak/tail sway, exhale returning toward first pose. Both feet planted.
Rows 2 and 3 (8 frames): ONE continuous clearly differentiated walking cycle, contact, down, passing, up, opposite contact, opposite down, opposite passing, opposite up. Alternate left/right legs and arm swing. Cloak follows with delayed motion. Distinct strides, no identical duplicates.
Row 4 (4 frames): jump preparation crouch; upward leap with extended rear leg and cloak trailing below; airborne apex with both knees tucked and tail balancing; falling with feet extended ready to land and cloak lifted.
Clean sharp alpha cutout, clear silhouette and highly readable limbs. This is a single character sheet, not an illustration of multiple different characters.
Character: QUIREL, the GOLDEN wanderer in the references (not the red lizard). Golden ochre scales, pale warm cream throat, amber eye, swept gold-brown spines, charcoal-brown ragged cloak with muted burgundy lining, bronze shoulder clasp, dark brown leather harness. Carry his slender dark wooden fighting staff with a small bronze tip in the near hand, angling upward to the right; it must fit inside the cell. No large magic flames or shield.
